feed.title: Oskar Austegard
feed.subtitle: Longer-form writing on AI, software, and building things.

entry.title: A Dataset With No Database
entry.summary: To ship structured data to an AI agent, skip the fancy formats: bundle a CSV in a skill and tell the agent to load it into SQLite. A tour of the alternatives, and why KISS and YAGNI win.

entry.title: A Knowledgebase With No Embedding Model
entry.summary: KB Packer turns a folder of documents into a portable, embedding-free .skill knowledgebase an AI agent can install and query — built entirely in the browser, byte-identical to the CLI.

entry.title: A jj-Native Hub for Claude Code on the Web
entry.summary: claude-jjithub-and-spoke is a CCotw template that gives Claude a jj (Jujutsu) VCS layer over GitHub — sibling of the gh-flavored and Tangled-flavored hubs.

entry.title: PostToolUse, Not FileChanged: Debugging Silent Hooks in Claude Code on the Web
entry.summary: Four hooks (SessionEnd, Stop, FileChanged, PostToolUse) and why only one of them fires for the agent's own edits in Claude Code on the Web.

entry.title: Hub, Spoke, and Raven: A Stateful Agent on Claude's Ephemeral Containers
entry.summary: How we turned Claude Code on the Web into a persistent multi-repo development environment with a stateful AI agent that remembers across sessions.

entry.title: Custom Container Layers for Claude's Ephemeral Machines
entry.summary: Claude's containers reset every session. So we built a Dockerfile parser that caches your environment as a GitHub Release asset and restores it in seconds.

entry.title: Claude Conversation Cache
entry.summary: A Chrome extension that intercepts Claude's API traffic and caches it locally, so when the UI crashes 90% through a response, you don't lose everything.

entry.title: What Can Claude Actually See? Mapping an AI's Visual Blindspots
entry.summary: 120+ controlled tests reveal where Claude's vision fails, where it matches humans, and where it diverges entirely. Then we built tools to compensate.

entry.title: Trust the Data, Not Your Imagination: Building an Image-to-SVG Skill
entry.summary: What happens when you pit a data-driven pipeline against 31 iterations of visual interpretation? A single automated pass matches the fidelity at half the file size.

entry.title: claude.ai/new UNOFFICIAL README
entry.summary: Unofficial reference for the query parameters that claude.ai/new accepts, such as q, skill-name, project, model and thinking, and how the client handles each.

entry.title: How Claude in Chrome Reverse-Engineered Claude's Undocumented `/new` Endpoint
entry.summary: Claude, running in Chrome, read the JavaScript bundles of claude.ai/new to find its query parameters. One of them, project, was undocumented.

entry.title: Numbers Every Claude.ai Container Skill Developer Should Know
entry.summary: Latency and token-cost numbers measured in a Claude.ai container in February 2026, with nine design rules for skill authors.

entry.title: Exploring Codebases: Progressive Disclosure Meets Hybrid Search
entry.summary: The exploring-codebases skill finds matches with ripgrep, expands each to its enclosing function or class with tree-sitter, and shows signatures first.

entry.title: GitHub CLI in Claude.ai Containers
entry.summary: How to install the gh CLI with apt in Claude.ai's container, which needs an allowlist entry and a GH_TOKEN, and why it beats curl for issues, PRs and runs.

entry.title: Progressive Disclosure in MCP Servers: Keeping LLM Context Lean
entry.summary: Five patterns for MCP servers that keep tool schemas and responses small: a gateway tool, on-demand discovery, embedded guidance, compact output and warnings.

entry.title: On AI in MCPS Schools - a reply to the MCCPTA Tech Committee
entry.summary: A letter to the MCCPTA Tech Committee on its draft resolution about AI in MCPS schools: it shares the concerns and argues for guided use over a moratorium.

entry.title: Portable Agent State with AgentFS: A Proof of Concept
entry.summary: A test of whether AgentFS, Turso's SQLite filesystem for agents, can carry state between local work and Claude's sandbox. It can, if the WAL file travels too.

entry.title: Olmo 3.1 32B Think: Advancing Open-Source AI with Deeper Reasoning and Unmatched Transparency
entry.summary: Olmo 3.1 32B Think was prompted to write a blog post about itself from Ai2's release announcement. Includes its reasoning trace and the result, as an anecdote.

entry.title: What Head Start Does
entry.summary: A description of Head Start that uses every one of the roughly 130 terms listed as forbidden in a filed exhibit.

entry.title: Claude User Style for eliciting honest self reporting
entry.summary: A Claude-written user style that adds a structured self-assessment to substantive answers, based on OpenAI's paper Training LLMs for Honesty via Confessions.

entry.title: My interview with the Claude AI Interviewer
entry.summary: Transcript of Anthropic's AI interviewer questioning the author on AI in daily life: persistent memory, how it could go wrong, and economic displacement.

entry.title: Code Mapping for AI-Assisted Development
entry.summary: The mapping-codebases skill writes _MAP.md files from tree-sitter parses, so Claude can read a codebase's structure without opening every file.

entry.title: Claude Desktop: The Missing Agentic Framework
entry.summary: Claude Desktop has projects, MCP and file access. Four additions would make it a multi-agent framework: project calls, tool scoping, shared context, handoffs.

entry.title: Claude Project Instructions Assistant
entry.summary: Instructions for a Claude.ai project that writes instructions for other projects, in full: a meta prompt that returns XML-structured prompts as artifacts.

entry.title: Managing Context Continuity in Claude Projects
entry.summary: A workflow that pairs Claude Projects with Claude Pruner to save long conversations as project knowledge or carry their context into a new chat.
